warranty.title: What happens if something goes wrong?
warranty.description: Cross-border furnishing carries real risks. We answer them with written commitments — not promises made after the fact.
warranty.commitment: Every commitment is documented — warranty terms, QC reports and claim procedures are part of your project file, not fine print.

cases.question: If it arrives damaged
cases.title: We repair or replace it — free.
cases.description: Every shipment is insured and photo-documented before dispatch. Report damage within 14 days of delivery; we arrange repair, replacement parts, or a remade piece at no cost.

cases.question: If there is a defect
cases.title: The warranty covers it in writing.
cases.description: 3-year structural warranty on frames and joinery, 2 years on mechanisms, finishes and upholstery. Terms are issued with your order confirmation — before production begins.

cases.question: If something is missing
cases.title: One contact resolves it, fast.
cases.description: Your project manager stays accountable after delivery — missing hardware and parts ship within 7 days, and every claim receives a response within 48 hours.
